chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir narrated to us from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad al-Basri from Ali ibn Asbat from Ja'far ibn Sama'a from more than one person from Zurara ibn A'yan. He said:
I asked Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him): What is the right that God has over His servants? He said: That they say only what they know, and that they stop at what they do not know.

key_terms.العباد: Servants/worshippers — human beings in their relationship of servitude to God
key_terms.حق الله: The right of God — an obligation owed to God; what God is due from His servants
key_terms.يقفوا عند ما لا يعلمون: To stop at what they do not know — intellectual and religious restraint, not pronouncing on matters beyond one's knowledge
key_terms.يقولوا ما يعلمون: To say only what they know — speaking with certainty and verified knowledge

ai.seo_question: What is God's right over His servants according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Zurara ibn A'yan, one of the most trusted companions of the Imams, asks Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) about God's fundamental right over human beings. The Imam's reply is a profound epistemological and ethical principle: the divine right over servants is that they speak only what they know and maintain silence (or restraint) where their knowledge ends. This teaching addresses the religious prohibition of speaking without knowledge (al-qawl bi-ghayri 'ilm), which was considered a grave matter in early Islamic scholarship, as it could lead to false attribution of rulings to God or the Prophet.
word_analysis: may God have mercy upon him

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masruq (rh) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from Mu`alla b. Muhammad al-Basri from `Ali b. Asbat from Ja`far b. Sama`a from another person from Zurara b. A`yan. He said:
I asked Aba Ja`far al-Baqir (as): What is the right that Allah has over a worshiper? He said: To say only that which they know, and to stop at that which they do not know.
